title: Print message
description: Write a line to standard output.
explanation: Write a line to standard output.
usage: Use this when you need to write a line to standard output.
mistakes: Use a newline character or string; std::endl also flushes the stream.

title: Variable
description: Declare and print an integer.
explanation: Declare and print an integer.
usage: Use this when you need to declare and print an integer.
mistakes: Types matter; implicit narrowing can lose information.

title: String
description: Store and print text.
explanation: Store and print text.
usage: Use this when you need to store and print text.
mistakes: std::string needs the string header.

title: Condition
code:
int score = 82;
if (score >= 60) { std::cout << "Passed\n"; } else { std::cout << "Retry\n"; }
description: Choose behavior based on a condition.
explanation: Choose behavior based on a condition.
usage: Use this when you need to choose behavior based on a condition.
mistakes: Use == for comparison rather than = assignment.

title: For loop
description: Repeat using an index.
explanation: Repeat using an index.
usage: Use this when you need to repeat using an index.
mistakes: Avoid unsigned underflow when counting down from container sizes.

title: Vector
description: Store a growable sequence.
explanation: Store a growable sequence.
usage: Use this when you need to store a growable sequence.
mistakes: at checks bounds; operator[] does not.

title: Range loop
description: Iterate directly over values.
explanation: Iterate directly over values.
usage: Use this when you need to iterate directly over values.
mistakes: Use a const reference loop variable for large objects.

title: Fixed array
description: Use a fixed-size standard array.
explanation: Use a fixed-size standard array.
usage: Use this when you need to use a fixed-size standard array.
mistakes: std::array size is part of its type.

title: Input line
description: Read a whole line including spaces.
explanation: Read a whole line including spaces.
usage: Use this when you need to read a whole line including spaces.
mistakes: getline after operator>> may consume a leftover newline.

title: Function
description: Define a reusable calculation.
explanation: Define a reusable calculation.
usage: Use this when you need to define a reusable calculation.
mistakes: Declare or define the function before calling it.

title: Reference
description: Give an existing object another name.
explanation: Give an existing object another name.
usage: Use this when you need to give an existing object another name.
mistakes: A reference must bind to a live object and cannot be reseated.

title: Pointer
description: Refer to a value by its address.
explanation: Refer to a value by its address.
usage: Use this when you need to refer to a value by its address.
mistakes: A raw pointer does not own the object it points to.

title: Class
description: Define a type with a constructor.
explanation: Define a type with a constructor.
usage: Use this when you need to define a type with a constructor.
mistakes: The constructor name must match the class; move needs utility.

title: Object
code:
std::pair<std::string, int> student{"Alex", 92};
std::cout << student.first << ": " << student.second << '\n';
description: Construct a pair of related values.
explanation: Construct a pair of related values.
usage: Use this when you need to construct a pair of related values.
mistakes: A pair has first and second members, not named record fields.

title: Sort vector
description: Sort a sequence with the STL.
explanation: Sort a sequence with the STL.
usage: Use this when you need to sort a sequence with the STL.
mistakes: sort mutates the vector and needs algorithm.

title: Map
description: Look up values using ordered keys.
explanation: Look up values using ordered keys.
usage: Use this when you need to look up values using ordered keys.
mistakes: at throws if a map key is absent.

title: Set
description: Keep distinct ordered values.
explanation: Keep distinct ordered values.
usage: Use this when you need to keep distinct ordered values.
mistakes: Set stores unique values and orders them by its comparator.

title: Lambda
code:
auto doubleValue = [](int value) { return value * 2; };
std::cout << doubleValue(3) << '\n';
description: Create a small inline function.
explanation: Create a small inline function.
usage: Use this when you need to create a small inline function.
mistakes: Capture external variables explicitly when a lambda needs them.

title: Smart pointer
description: Manage heap memory with automatic cleanup.
explanation: Manage heap memory with automatic cleanup.
usage: Use this when you need to manage heap memory with automatic cleanup.
mistakes: unique_ptr cannot be copied; use move to transfer ownership.

title: Read file
description: Read lines using an automatically closed stream.
explanation: Read lines using an automatically closed stream.
usage: Use this when you need to read lines using an automatically closed stream.
mistakes: A failed file open leaves the stream false and the loop does not run.

title: Write file
description: Write text through an output file stream.
explanation: Write text through an output file stream.
usage: Use this when you need to write text through an output file stream.
mistakes: Check the output stream before writing and remember that opening truncates.

title: Exceptions
description: Catch an exception by const reference.
explanation: Catch an exception by const reference.
usage: Use this when you need to catch an exception by const reference.
mistakes: Catch exceptions by const reference to avoid slicing.

title: Optional
description: Represent a value that may be absent.
explanation: Represent a value that may be absent.
usage: Use this when you need to represent a value that may be absent.
mistakes: value_or provides a fallback for an empty optional.

title: Accumulate
description: Reduce a range to a sum.
explanation: Reduce a range to a sum.
usage: Use this when you need to reduce a range to a sum.
mistakes: The initial accumulator determines the numeric result type.

title: Template function
code:
template <typename T>
T larger(T a, T b) { return a > b ? a : b; }
description: Write a function that works with multiple types.
explanation: Write a function that works with multiple types.
usage: Use this when you need to write a function that works with multiple types.
mistakes: Template definitions generally need to be visible to their callers.

title: Const reference
description: Pass a string without copying or modifying it.
explanation: Pass a string without copying or modifying it.
usage: Use this when you need to pass a string without copying or modifying it.
mistakes: A const reference avoids copying, but it must not outlive the original object.

title: Complete grade report
description: Calculate a vector average using the STL.
explanation: Calculate a vector average using the STL.
usage: Use this when you need to calculate a vector average using the STL.
mistakes: Guard against an empty vector before dividing by size.
